title: OutpostSpendsSequenceRecord
description: The shape of one record in Outpost's "Spends" sequence (see docs/Sequences.txt) -- a historical log of every commodity-hand spend this game. Unlike a per-player sequence, this one's <count>/<body> ignore i_PlayerName entirely: every viewer sees the exact same records, since spend history has never been secret information. No longer part of the regular FSS body (OutpostSchema.json) at all -- by default nothing about this sequence is sent except its count, under sequences.Spends in the fullState envelope; a client downloads a range of these records on demand via the sequence request mechanism.

resources.description: Public (non-secret) description of the commodities spent.
